```python
        # Retry 429
        if status == 429:
            return True
        # Retry all 5xx

            return True
        # Never retry other 4xx (400-499 excluding 429)

            return False
        # For other statuses (1xx, 2xx, 3xx), default to False
        return False
    else:
        # Status is None, check error value
        if error == 'timeout' or error == 'connection':
            return True
        # Unknown errors must be false
        return False
```
